This script is for data checking and cleaning. The processed data will be saved in 'cleaned' folder.

Read OTU and check.

```{r}

biom <- import_biom('~/Desktop/Link to Zhengxu/DataSet/extracted_files/otus/100nt/gg-13_8-97-percent/otu_table.biom')

```

Clean meta data. Some variable selection processes may apply.
Following content last edited on 5/13/2025

```{r}
ids <- colnames(biom@otu_table)
# ids <- as.character(ids$x)
meta <- read_tsv("extracted_files/meta/ag-cleaned.txt")
meta <- meta%>%filter(`#SampleID`%in%ids)
# There are 17348 samples match ID.
```

Construct pet ownership variable based on Kate's programme.

```{r}
#Remove participants whose answer to cat or dog ownership is not provided.
# c(CAT, DOG)
# create variables for dog_o, cat_o. 
# create variable for pet_0: 1, 0 for own or no own pet.
# create only cat and only dog, cat_only, dog_only
# create own both cat and dog, cat_and_dog
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(dog_o = NA,
         dog_o = ifelse(DOG%in%c("false","No"),0, ifelse(DOG%in%c("true","Yes"),1, dog_o)),
         cat_o = NA,
         cat_o = ifelse(CAT%in%c("false","No"),0, ifelse(CAT%in%c("true","Yes"),1, cat_o)),
         dog_only = dog_o*(1-cat_o),
         cat_only = cat_o*(1-dog_o),
         cat_and_dog = cat_o*dog_o)%>%
  filter(!is.na(cat_o))%>%
  filter(!is.na(dog_o))
# 16656 samples
```

Construct CVD variable

```{r}
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(cvd = NA,
         cvd = ifelse(CARDIOVASCULAR_DISEASE=="Diagnosed by a medical professional (doctor, physician assistant)",1,ifelse(CARDIOVASCULAR_DISEASE=="I do not have this condition",0,cvd)))
meta <- meta%>%filter(!is.na(cvd))
# 11988 samples 
```

Pick covariates/confounders.

```{r}
meta <- meta%>%
  filter(!AGE_CORRECTED%in%c("Unknown", "Unspecified"))%>%
  mutate(age=as.numeric(AGE_CORRECTED),
         bmi=as.numeric(BMI),
         bmi_cat=as.numeric(BMI_CAT))%>%
  filter(age>39)
# modify sex variable
meta <- meta%>%mutate(sex = ifelse(SEX%in%c('other','Not provided','unspecified','Unknown'),NA,SEX))
# summary(test$bmi)
#Remove participants whose age is NA.
#Remove participants <40 years.
#Remove participants whose bmi >220
# 7095 samples
#Select people only from USA.
meta <- meta%>%filter(COUNTRY=="USA")

# modify bmi of cat
meta <- meta%>%
  filter(bmi<220)

meta <- meta%>%
  filter(as.numeric(HEIGHT_CM)>=140)%>%
  filter(as.numeric(HEIGHT_CM)<=200)%>%
  filter(as.numeric(WEIGHT_KG)<=200)%>%
  filter(as.numeric(WEIGHT_KG)>=35)
```

Make ordinal variables to be continuous variables, exercise, alcohol, smoking.

```{r}

# life style
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(alcohol_frequency = ifelse(ALCOHOL_FREQUENCY%in%c('Not provided','Unspecified','Unknown'),NA,ALCOHOL_FREQUENCY),
         smoking_frequency = ifelse(SMOKING_FREQUENCY%in%c('Not provided','Unspecified','Unknown'),NA,SMOKING_FREQUENCY),
         exercise_frequency = ifelse(EXERCISE_FREQUENCY%in%c('Not provided','Unspecified','Unknown'),NA,EXERCISE_FREQUENCY),
         level_of_education = ifelse(LEVEL_OF_EDUCATION%in%c('Not provided','Unspecified','Unknown'),NA,LEVEL_OF_EDUCATION))

meta <- meta%>%mutate(diet_type=ifelse(DIET_TYPE%in%c('Unspecified','Not provided','Unknown'),NA,DIET_TYPE))

#Sleep duration; categorize as adequate (6 hours or more) or inadequate (<6 hours)
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(sleep_duration = ifelse(SLEEP_DURATION%in%c("Unknown","Unspecified"), NA, SLEEP_DURATION),
         sleep_duration_regroup = ifelse(sleep_duration%in%c('Less than 5 hours', '5-6 hours'),
                                        'Inadequate', ifelse(sleep_duration%in%c('6-7 hours', '7-8 hours', '8 or more hours'), 'Adequate', sleep_duration)))


meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(exercise_recode = do.call(fct_recode,c(list(exercise_frequency), setNames(c("Never", "Rarely (a few times/month)", "Occasionally (1-2 times/week)", "Regularly (3-5 times/week)","Daily"), c( 0, 3, 11, 16, 30)))),
         exercise_recode = as.numeric(as.character(exercise_recode)),
         smoking_recode = do.call(fct_recode,c(list(smoking_frequency), setNames(c("Never", "Rarely (a few times/month)", "Occasionally (1-2 times/week)", "Regularly (3-5 times/week)","Daily"), c( 0, 3, 11, 16, 30)))),
         smoking_recode = as.numeric(as.character(smoking_recode)),
         
         smoker = ifelse(smoking_frequency%in%c("Rarely (a few times/month)", "Occasionally (1-2 times/week)", "Regularly (3-5 times/week)","Daily"),"Smoker",ifelse(smoking_frequency=="Never","Non-Smoker",NA)),
         
         education_recode = ifelse(level_of_education%in%c('Did not complete high school', 'High School or GED equilivant',"Associate's degree", "Bachelor's degree", "Some college or technical school" ),'Up to Undergrad',NA),
         education_recode = ifelse(level_of_education%in%c("Graduate or Professional degree", "Some graduate school or professional"),'Some grad school or grad degree',education_recode))
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(protein_intake = ifelse(DIET_TYPE%in%c("Omnivore","Omnivore but do not eat red meat","Vegetarian but eat seafood"),"yes",
                                 ifelse(DIET_TYPE%in%c("Unknown","Unspecified"),NA,"no")))
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(antibiotic_recent_take = ifelse(ANTIBIOTIC_HISTORY%in%c("I have not taken antibiotics in the past year."),"no",
                                         ifelse(ANTIBIOTIC_HISTORY%in%c("Unspecified","Unknown"),NA,"yes")))
```

Then separate race into caucasian or not. Age under 55, 55-60, and over 60. Not pretty sure whether these are necessary. Following contents were edited on 05/20/2025.

```{r}
meta <- meta%>%mutate(
  race_recode = ifelse(RACE%in%c("Unknown","Unspecified"),NA,RACE),
  race_recode = ifelse(race_recode%in%c("Caucasian"),"Caucasian","Non-Caucasian"),
  age_group55 = ifelse(age>54,"55orOlder","under55"),
  age_group60 = ifelse(age>59,"60orOlder","under60"),
  age_group65 = ifelse(age>64,"65orOlder","under65")
)
```

Update: 06092025
The BMI has some problems, due to some problem in weight and height.
Based on the paper about Data Publication, some thresholds are set to exclude samples
with invalid weight and height.

Ranges are: 140-200cm for height, 35-200kg for weight

```{r}
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(age_group_in_4 = ifelse(age<50,"40 to 49",
                                 ifelse(age<60,"50 to 59",
                                        ifelse(age<70,"60 to 69", "70+"))),
         pet_status = "No Pet",
         pet_status = ifelse(cat_only==1,"Cat Only",pet_status),
         pet_status = ifelse(dog_only==1,"Dog Only",pet_status),
         pet_status = ifelse(cat_and_dog==1,"Cat and Dog",pet_status),
         no_pet = 1-cat_only-dog_only-cat_and_dog)
```

Check about the distribution of demography and some thing.
```{r}
meta <- meta%>%
  mutate(alcohol_recode = do.call(fct_recode,c(list(alcohol_frequency), setNames(c("Never", "Rarely (a few times/month)", "Occasionally (1-2 times/week)", "Regularly (3-5 times/week)","Daily"), c( 0, 3, 11, 16, 30)))))
meta <- meta%>%filter(!is.na(sex))
colnames(meta)[1] <- "ID"

meta <- meta%>%filter(!is.na(sleep_duration_regroup),
                      # !is.na(sex),
                      !is.na(smoking_frequency),
                      !is.na(exercise_frequency),
                      !is.na(alcohol_frequency),
                      !is.na(education_recode),
                      !is.na(protein_intake),
                      !is.na(antibiotic_recent_take))
meta <- meta%>%mutate(cvd = as.factor(cvd))
```


```{r}
depth_raw <- data.frame(cbind(colnames(biom@otu_table),apply(biom@otu_table,2, sum)))
depth_raw$X2 <- as.numeric(depth_raw$X2)

meta <- meta%>%
  filter(ID%in%depth_raw$X1[depth_raw$X2>=1250])

biom@otu_table <- otu_table(subset(biom@otu_table,select = meta$ID))
```
